annotations.title: Get notices from India's district websites

description: Tenders, recruitment and announcements from the official websites of India's 748 districts (collector offices), by state and district: title (often Hindi or the state language), date, district, state, official PDF link. Newest first. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/india-district-notices on your Apify account (about $0.003 per notice; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 30, max 500). Cost scales with this.

posted_within_days.description: Only notices dated in the last N days (0 = any).

states.description: States or union territories by name or ISO code, e.g. ["Bihar"], ["IN-UP"]. Up to 120 districts per call.

name: get_india_district_notices

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Get notices from India's district websites
